answer:
I don't know of a promptfoo command that exports an evaluation to Parquet. The retrieved documents never mention Parquet.

What they do document:

- `promptfoo export eval <evalId>` exports to JSON only: "Export an eval record to JSON format. To export the most recent, use `latest`." [promptfoo/site/docs/usage/command-line.md]
- Its only option is `-o, --output <filepath>`, described as "File to write. Writes to stdout by default." [promptfoo/site/docs/usage/command-line.md]
- `promptfoo eval --output` can write other formats. The docs show an XML example: "promptfoo eval --output results.xml" [promptfoo/site/docs/configuration/outputs.md]

For the full list of supported output formats, see the output formats page (`promptfoo/site/docs/configuration/outputs.md`). The excerpts I have don't show whether Parquet is among them.
